document_contents.quote: On inspection, following defects were noticed by the Officials: (i) Input Tax Credit Mismatch between GSTR-3B Vs GSTR-2A, for the Financial Year 2021-22 (ii) Non-payment of Tax in certain transactions.

Hence, the petitioner filed their reply dated 03.01.2024, clarifying the said discrepancies, however, even then, the respondents issued the reminders dated 04.03.2024 & 27.06.2024, directing the petitioner to pay the tax demands as proposed in the show cause notice.
